name: The R Villa Swantika

facts.text: 2 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, and 2 full bathrooms.
Private pool with direct access from the living room.
A garden, an outdoor dining area, sun chairs and a private entrance.

facts.source: Elev8 listing title (the questionnaire description also mentions rice field views)

facts.text: Air conditioning, WiFi and a TV.
Kitchen with stove, microwave, kettle, toaster, pots and pans, dishes and utensils.
Hair dryer, iron and ironing board; linens are provided.
On Jalan Sempol in Pererenan, about 40 minutes from Ngurah Rai Airport.
facts.source: Elev8 questionnaire (how to find the property)

open: Rice field views are only mentioned in the questionnaire description. Say 'green nature views' and nothing more.
The questionnaire lists a bathtub in the family amenities. This is unclear. Do not mention a bathtub.
The villa is not beachfront. Give no beach distance.
Elev8 lists a size of 220 without saying what it measures (plot or building). Do not state a size.
Hot tub, barbecue, gym, cinema and rooftop are not confirmed. Do not mention them.
Everything on this sheet comes from the Elev8 questionnaire and is still to be confirmed by the owner.
catalog: Sleeps up to 4 guests in 2 bedrooms with king-size beds and 2 full bathrooms.
Private pool with direct access from the living room, a garden, an outdoor dining area and sun chairs, with green nature views.
Air conditioning, WiFi, TV and a kitchen with stove, microwave, kettle and toaster.
